speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your symptoms, can you tell me how old you are? Also, have you noticed any bleeding from your gums or nose recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does she have any swollen lymph nodes in her neck, armpits, or groin area? Have you noticed any small red or purple spots on her skin that do not fade when pressed?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and easy bruising. I also have Fever, Severe leg pain that disturbs sleep.

speaker: Doctor
text: I will request a complete blood count and a peripheral blood smear to evaluate for potential bone marrow pathology. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count

text: RESULTS: Hemoglobin: 10.1 g/dL, Leukocyte Count: 63,000/mm3 (elevated), Platelet Count: 27,000/mm3 (decreased)

speaker: Doctor
text: The blood results show high white cells, low platelets, and anemia, which is concerning for leukemia. Can you tell me if you have noticed any abdominal swelling or bone tenderness when I press on your legs?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Unremarkable past medical history. Social history: Attends preschool. Lives with parents and one younger sibling.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any abdominal swelling or bone tenderness when I press on your legs? Also, have you noticed any small red or purple spots on her skin that do not fade when pressed?

speaker: Patient
text: Positive for fever, bruising, and bone pain. Denies cough, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, or urinary symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: I will request a peripheral blood smear to identify the type of white blood cells present. REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_Blood_Smear

speaker: Doctor
text: That is highly unusual; a peripheral smear in acute leukemia typically shows blasts, so let me request a bone marrow aspiration to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Bone_Marrow_Aspiration

text: RESULTS: Findings: Predominantly immature cells that are positive for CD10, CD19, and TdT.

speaker: Doctor
text: The bone marrow findings of CD10, CD19, and TdT positive immature cells confirm a diagnosis of B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia. DIAGNOSIS READY: B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
